title: Patient stories
intro: Real treatment journeys from Harbourline patients, shared with their permission and in their own words.

stories.name: Margaret, 67, Bristol
stories.text: I had worn a lower denture for twenty years and it never stayed put. Two implants changed that. I can eat an apple again, and I stopped worrying about it moving when I talk. Dr Mehta explained every step and the whole thing took about four months.

stories.name: James, 34, Bath
stories.text: My front teeth had crowded again since my braces as a teenager. Eight months of aligners and they are straight. The hardest part was remembering to put them back in after lunch. Dr Lang was honest that I would need to wear a retainer for good.

stories.name: Aisha, 29, Leeds
stories.text: I had not been to a dentist for nine years because I was embarrassed. Priya never made me feel judged. My gums bled every time I brushed; after three cleaning sessions and a lot of practice with interdental brushes, they do not bleed at all.

stories.name: The Okafor family, Bristol
stories.text: Both our children have been coming since they were babies. Tom makes the visits feel like a game, and neither of them has needed a filling. They actually ask when the next visit is.
